lastText: The Night EndsThe Last SunsetNew Ending Discovered · 1 / 15FOREIGN NOBLEMAN DIES IN THE CARPATHIANSYou are in your box on a wagon on a road in the mountains, at the end of a clear day. The sun is on the rim of the pass. Five men come over the ridge, and behind them a woman with a typewriter. Somebody says your name. A long knife goes across your throat and a short one into your heart, and it hurts for as long as it takes to say so. Then the earth is over you, and you are dust. The woman writes afterwards that there was a look of peace on your face. You will never know whether she is right. The stories that last are not about a monster. They are about a very old man in a very large house, who stood at windows and watched people go by. The children in the village say that he used to leave bread on the sill. Nobody can say who it was for.
